Solibri

Solibri focuses on model checking, information validation and BIM coordination review.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Run a rules-based model check

Start from the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended Solibri preview, run a rules-based model check; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Classify coordination issues

Begin with the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended Solibri preview, classify coordination issues; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Report model-quality findings

Use the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended Solibri preview, report model-quality findings; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
